name: Tabs
description: Keyboard-navigable content switching through a compact item interface.
usage:
<Tabs
  aria-label="Account sections"
  defaultValue="profile"
  items={[
    { value: 'profile', label: 'Profile', content: <ProfilePanel /> },
    { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing', content: <BillingPanel /> },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: The tablist row that owns arrow-key movement between tabs.
Each trigger; the selected one sets aria-selected and drives the visible panel.
The content region labelled by its tab, shown one at a time.

dos: Keep tab labels to one or two words.
Set defaultValue so a sensible panel is visible on first render.
Control selection with value and onValueChange when a route or parent owns it.
donts: Don't use tabs to navigate between routes; use Sub Nav so links stay links.
Don't nest a tab list inside another tab panel.
Don't use tabs for a sequential flow; use Steps.

examples.title: Sections
examples.description: Tabs follow the ARIA authoring practices keyboard pattern out of the box.

examples.title: Profile sections
examples.description: Use tabs for peer views that share the same route context.

examples.title: Responsive tab list
examples.description: Long tab labels remain reachable through horizontal scrolling.

guidance.useWhen: Related views share a context and users switch between them.
guidance.avoidWhen: Views need independent URLs or a long sequence of steps.
guidance.behavior: Arrow keys move between tabs and the active panel is announced.
guidance.responsive: Allow tab labels to scroll rather than wrap into ambiguous rows.

keyboard.action: Moves between tabs and activates them.
Activates the first or last tab.
Moves focus from the active tab into its panel.

notes: Implements the ARIA tabs pattern with tablist, tab, and tabpanel roles.
aria-label on the tab list describes what the tabs switch between.
Disabled tabs are skipped during arrow-key navigation.

props.description: Accessible name for the tab list.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Called with the new value when the active tab changes.
props.name: onValueChange
